column1: # gate-policy.tsv — the online specs each gate-map.tsv class requires.
# Format: <class> TAB <tokens> [TAB <advisory>]. `#` starts a comment line. Tokens are
# space-separated: a canonical online spec (`gates.sh --online-spec-set`), ALL (every
# canonical spec), ANY (at least one online spec, the cheapest), or - (none). The optional
# advisory is printed on stderr whenever a changed file falls in that class.
# A `<class>@remote` row replaces `<class>`'s row for the remote twin
# (TMP_GATES_LANE=remote, set by .github/workflows/remote-lane.yml); the unit's release run
# Every class gate-map.tsv names must appear here (Rust gate in fixture_gates.rs).
# The unit lane's own runner, judge and lock: every unit run goes through them, but the remote
# twin runs scripts/e2e-remote.sh and never touches them.
# The twin's own runner and config: the unit's release run never touches them.
# An online spec file's own edit requires that spec alone: a spec change cannot move the
# product code the other specs exercise.
# Every online run opens the HID transport and seeds (imports and saves) before its spec, so
# one spec proves a dependency bump still drives the device; the advisory covers the crates
# that also carry audio and the app shell.
